fields.description: Which AI reads visiting cards and writes website summaries
fields.label: AI Provider

fields.description: Only for OpenAI-compatible services. Leave empty for OpenAI itself.
fields.label: OpenAI Base URL

fields.description: On: a business saved with a new email gets the welcome email automatically, once. Off: emails go only when staff click Send Welcome Email on a business. The button works either way.
fields.label: Send Welcome Email Automatically

fields.description: The address welcome emails are sent from. Add it first in Desk → Email Account with Enable Outgoing ticked. Leave empty to use the default outgoing account.
fields.label: Send From

fields.description: On: on the 1st of each month at 10:00, every business with activity last month gets a WhatsApp report (AI crawler reads, visitors from AI apps, page views, taps) on the first number on its page. Each message has a fee from Meta.
fields.label: Send Monthly WhatsApp Report

fields.description: From Meta WhatsApp Manager → API Setup (the ID, not the phone number itself)
fields.label: WhatsApp Phone Number ID

fields.description: A permanent System User token from Meta Business Settings, with whatsapp_business_messaging permission
fields.label: WhatsApp Access Token

fields.description: An approved Utility template with 9 body variables: {{1}} business name, {{2}} month, {{3}} AI crawler reads, {{4}} visitors from AI apps, {{5}} page views, {{6}} WhatsApp taps, {{7}} calls, {{8}} contact saves, {{9}} page link
fields.label: Template Name

fields.description: The template's language code in WhatsApp Manager, e.g. en or en_US
fields.label: Template Language

fields.description: e.g. v23.0. Leave empty to use your Meta app's default version.
fields.label: Graph API Version
